Complex natural spatial organization across several scales, coherent broad quiet areas interrupted by asymmetric detailed branching boundaries; absolutely no uniform isotropic noise carpet or tiled repeating stamps. Clean continuous tonal fields with fine crisp branching structures where specified. Regional geology tendency map for a 114.688 km square arid basalt plateau. Black 0 means quiet continuous fines, midgray mixed weathered ground, white 1 fragmented exposed rock tendency. No hydraulic rivers drawn as luminous lines.
